description:
An easy-to-use Windows manager for personal game servers.

Synix Control Panel installs, configures, updates, monitors, and backs up personal game servers from one Windows application.
v1.0.26 improves installation, updates, server setup, diagnostics, and international language support.

Expanded interface translations to 27 language options: English, French, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Dutch, Swedish, Czech, Ukrainian, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian Bokmål, Greek, Hungarian, Romanian, Hindi, and Thai.
Added a branded installation wizard with license acceptance and an application-folder selector. Setup now distinguishes fresh installation, same-version repair or uninstall, and updates to newer versions. Fixed repair handling for rebuilt installers of the same version. Existing game servers and their data remain in their original locations.
Added uninstall choices for removing only Synix or also removing managed servers and Synix data. App-only removal preserves the server list, server files, and backups for reinstallation. Deleting backups requires a separate choice and confirmation.
Improved installed and standalone update detection. Standalone copies update in place without switching to an MSI installation.
Fixed server settings advancing to Review while typing passwords. Users now continue to Review explicitly before saving. Added game-specific international-character guidance for server names and passwords, plus safer installation-folder naming.
Expanded Server History with persistent, searchable per-server diagnostics, startup and shutdown events, connection results, errors, updates, backups, and restores. Details can be copied, with sensitive values filtered before storage.
Added dashboard backup status showing completed backup age, failures, and missing backups. Improved Server History styling, server-grid readability, translated layouts, and keyboard navigation.
Corrected game catalog entries, Steam download settings, and installation requirements, and updated the game-list documentation.
